'''Chivas''' was a senior [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Chivas received [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Jedi academy|academy]]. Soon after the [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|battle]] at [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], Padawan Chivas joined fellow apprentice [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] as part of Green team in a competition arranged by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Taria Damsin]]. The competition, taking place in the new [[Sublevel nineteen training dojo]], ended in a tie. During the trial, Chivas managed to take out two modified [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] as Green team crossed a river. Chivas was one of the two members of Green Team to make it all the way through the dojo.<ref name="CWGS" />
